question: Can a learned witness-only model safely infer supported temporal relationships when event_id and known-status metadata from R4 are absent? Does it improve over the frozen strong R5B witness rule on independent challenge inputs?

input_contract.ground_truth: Hidden scenario-derived label held by synthetic evaluator, excluded from input model feature extractor
input_contract.source_independence: Only simulated, distinct root strings; source independent-authentication NOT demonstrated.
input_contract.physical_event_identity: No event-id reconstruction or fabricated occurrence claim. Similar source content does not prove same physical event.

split_and_model.same_scenario_generator_warning: Shared synthetic scenario family across train and test. This is source-root-disjoint but NOT an independently authored or sealed blind test.
split_and_model.feature_policy: Numerical aggregates of visible witness evidence only; neither IDs nor hidden labels nor source root literal strings fed to model.
split_and_model.learner: 5-class linear softmax SGD, 36 epochs, learning_rate 0.085, weights frozen before heldout test
split_and_model.threshold_selection: Validation only: choose widest coverage with zero unsupported claims and >=0.98 selective accuracy; candidate thresholds [0.50,0.60,0.70,0.80,0.90,0.95,0.98,0.995,1.01]. Threshold 1.01 enforces abstention if none qualifies.
split_and_model.test_protocol: Evaluate exactly once on heldout after validation-only threshold selection, no post-hoc threshold adjustments

paired_arms.A: Original tools.keto_reference.summarize_case, preserved and not scored as temporal classifier
paired_arms.B: R5C learned witness-only softmax with validation-chosen rejection threshold

primary: Selective accuracy conditional on answered examples
Unsupported positive claims on required-abstention cases
secondary: Total training runtime distinct from inference runtime
Per-case median inference microseconds on a single uncalibrated CI worker
metrics.statistical_note: 320 synthetic examples from one generator do not represent 320 independent physical experiments or medical subjects. No p-value for general intelligence gain from synthetic examples.

promotion_policy.engineering_pass: CI executes reproducibly, 25 new tests pass, zero model inferences on real data, no feature leakage, no production changes; model accuracy is reported even when poor.
promotion_policy.scientific_pass: Impossible under this synthetic-only protocol: independent external witness provenance and source-authored hidden tasks not available.
promotion_policy.neural_gain: Strict descriptive gain only if B has 0 unsupported claims and 0 wrong nonabstentions and higher coverage than C; any such synthetic result still requires external independent replication and compute cost accounting.

epistemic_boundaries: OPEN-009 prospective frozen targets are separate from a valid demonstration of future-to-past information.
ZENO drand negative result must remain a negative control.
Distributed timestamp inversion is not physical retrocausality.
Subjective day relabeling is not physical change of yesterday.
No Alzheimer disease or consciousness diagnosis.
Only synthetic records and public metadata may be processed.
next_required: External provenance-authenticated witness dataset and truly blind competing-model challenge from a source-independent custodian
